items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I did a lot of work as a substitute for Sidney.

ctx.x: So, I didn't stay there, that's when I met Wilbur DeParis, in fact I joined Wilbur DeParis as a -- I did a lot of work as a substitute for Sidney. Cause he would take off a lot, he was involved in a religious thing, and he would take off a lot and so I started playing with Wilbur DeParis' band at that time.
But you also -- in '51 you toured with -- you went back with Calloway, didn't you?
